portInfo.description: Cruise Santander’s infrastructures page highlights a Maritime Station in the heart of the city that lets cruise passengers move between ship and city with complete flexibility, and notes citizens can view ships from the city. Shore-excursion themes on the same site include Santillana/Altamira, Cabárceno and Picos de Europa — those are coach products, not walk-offs.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Santander Maritime Station (cruise) — Santander, Cantabria, Spain
gettingThere.distanceToCity: City centre. Maritime Station described as in the heart of the city. Minutes not surveyed — allow 10–20 min estimate. Cabárceno / Altamira / Picos. Site lists shore excursions — long calls only.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm you are at the Maritime Station, not a remote cargo quay.
